net.coobird.thumbnailator.builders.ThumbnailParameterBuilder builder = new net.coobird.thumbnailator.builders.ThumbnailParameterBuilder();
builder.size(100, 100);

net.coobird.thumbnailator.builders.ThumbnailParameterBuilder returnedBuilder = builder.quality(0.75f);
assert returnedBuilder == builder : "Builder should return itself for method chaining";

net.coobird.thumbnailator.ThumbnailParameter param = builder.build();
float q = param.getQuality();

assert Math.abs(q - 0.75f) < 0.0001f : "Quality was not set correctly in the built ThumbnailParameter";
System.out.println("__CHECK__ quality " + q);
